name: Explorer pony
tips: `git clone` copies a whole project to your computer, history included, so you can read every file.
`ls -a` shows hidden files too: their names start with a dot, and they often hold settings.
`tree -L 2` draws a folder and its subfolders, two levels deep: a quick map of a new project.
personal: You went through the repo! Real explorers read the code.
Every folder is a new trail.
I always say what I see: that file needs a README.
